name: Frost Fighters
body:
School conjuration (summoning) [cold]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect four summoned ice elementals
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell summons four small ice elementals (which look like soft-looking clumps of snow). They appear where the caster wishes and can act immediately. The elementals do their best to defend the caster and attack his enemies. If the caster can communicate with the elementals, they can be instructed to take other actions. They obey the caster to the best of their ability. (Ice elementals are earth elementals modified with the ice elemental template.) As with all summoned monsters, these ice elementals cannot be summoned into an environment that cannot support them.
